features.label: The most misread
features.detail: Appropriated by people he would have despised and quoted against his own arguments. Reading him cold is genuinely risky.

features.label: Aphorism as weapon
features.detail: Writes in fragments that resist summary. Any tidy version of Nietzsche is a wrong one.

features.label: Collapsed at forty-four
features.detail: Went irreversibly insane and never wrote again. The late work is written against a closing window.
